calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences. Focus on: what was discussed (product, features, pain points), key participants and their roles, next steps/action items.

Key participants: Jake Heier (GrowthBook account team), Bryce Fitzsimons (GrowthBook engineer), Leonid Gilburd (Plusgrade), Lori Livadariu (Plusgrade data science), Kerem Ataman (Plusgrade), Nikhil Vemgal (Plusgrade data scientist), Simo Benkirane (Plusgrade). Plusgrade's pain points: need backend A/B testing with deterministic hashing based on booking IDs, strict approval workflows, self-hosted/air-gapped, support for scheduling experiments, multi-armed bandits (non-contextual currently), Snowflake integration (nice-to-have). GrowthBook features discussed: Python SDK, deterministic bucketing, SSO, approval flows, audit logs, self-hosting with air gap, scheduled experiments (basic), bandits (Thompson sampling), Snowflake connector.

Next steps: Set up a demo call with GrowthBook data science team, provide enterprise trial/playground access for Plusgrade to test.
